preconditions.expression: all(line.strip() == '' or (line.strip().isdigit() and int(line.strip()) % 2 == 1 and 61 < int(line.strip()) < 10**6) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() != '0')
preconditions.description: Each non-terminating line in stdin contains an odd integer strictly between 61 and 10^6.
The input sequence is terminated by a line containing exactly 0.

preconditions.expression: len([line for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and line.strip() != '0']) <= 1000
preconditions.description: There are at most 1000 query lines before the terminating 0.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.strip().splitlines()) == len([line for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and line.strip() != '0'])
postconditions.description: The number of output lines equals the number of input queries.

postconditions.expression: all((lambda parts: (len(parts) == 3 and all(p.isdigit() for p in parts) and (int(parts[0]) == 0 and int(parts[1]) == 0 and int(parts[2]) == 0) or (is_prime(int(parts[0])) and is_prime(int(parts[1])) and is_prime(int(parts[2])) and int(parts[0]) + int(parts[1])**2 + int(parts[2])**3 == int(query))))(line.strip().split()) for line, query in zip(stdout.strip().splitlines(), [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and line.strip() != '0']))
postconditions.description: For each input number, the output line contains either '0 0 0' or three primes P1, P2, P3 such that P1 + P2^2 + P3^3 equals the input number.
